newsitem.title: USA: Metricom sale, merger proposal withdrawn.
newsitem.headline: Metricom sale, merger proposal withdrawn.

text.p: Metricom Inc said Thursday a shareholder has withdrawn its proposal for the annual meeting regarding the sale or merger of the company.
The company, which provides wireless data communications network solutions, said the shareholder indicated that it believed that Metricom had tried to address shareholder concerns.
Metricom's 1997 annual shareholder's meeting will be held on May 1, it said.
In December, Ryback Management Corp presented a proxy proposal recommending a sale, merger or other business combination with another company to maximize the value of Metricom's stock.
Ryback holds a 27.4-percent stake in Metricom, which is based in Las Gatos, California.
